name: Keen Hearing and Smell
text: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

name: Pack Tactics
text: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 1.5 m. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

name: Bite
text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 1.5 m., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Scimitar
text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 1.5 m, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Redirect Attack
text: When a creature the chief can see targets it with an attack, the chief chooses another goblin within 1.5 m. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

name: Longbow
text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 45/180 m, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
